# TRITECH FORENSICS TRAINING

> TRITECH FORENSICS TRAINING provides comprehensive forensic science education and IAI certification courses through a network of host agencies and qualified instructors.

TRITECH FORENSICS TRAINING is an exclusive IAI (International Association for Identification) training partner offering hands-on forensic courses in disciplines including bloodstain pattern analysis, fingerprint analysis, and evidence collection. The organization works with host agencies nationwide and internationally to deliver professional development and certification programs for forensic professionals.

## Key Topics

- Forensic training
- IAI certification
- Bloodstain pattern analysis
- Fingerprint analysis
- Evidence collection
- Host agency network
- Professional development
- Forensic science
- LearningStream platform
- International Association for Identification
- Course hosting
- Forensic photography
- Hands-on training
- Tri-Tech Forensics products
